<b>Kratt</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|Merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. He offers a hot spa service at the [[Flea Caravan]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]].

== Background ==
Kratt previously travelled alone with his special carriage, which is later revealed to function as a spa. He sought out to join the Flea Caravan.

== In-game Events ==
Inside a cave behind a breakable wall in [[Greymoor]], Kratt is found trapped in silk beside his carriage. After Hornet breaks the silk and frees him, he mentions wanting to reward Hornet with something inside his carriage, and leaves to join the [[Flea Caravan]]. 

Kratt is considered a [[Flea]], counting for the Wish <i>[[The Lost Fleas]]</i> if five Fleas have not already been freed. As such, his rescue is also necessary for <i>[[Ecstasy of the End]]</i>. 

After resting on any bench not in Flea Caravan,<ref>Flag <code>CaravanLechReturnedToCaravan</code> set in <code>GameManager.TimePasses()</code>.</ref> the next time Hornet sees the Caravan, Kratt is there with his metal carriage. Upon speaking, he offers his hot spa service to Hornet for {{R|10}}. Should Hornet accept, the carriage next to Kratt opens its door for Hornet to enter. 

Inside the carriage is a pool of hot water; standing in the water gradually regenerates Hornet's health and Silk to full. After being in the spa for a few seconds, Kratt makes noises and slowly rises up to peek through a window at the top of the carriage, spying on Hornet in the bath, at which point Hornet can jump up and hit him. If Hornet does not hit him fast enough, Kratt will duck away for a few seconds before peeping again.

After exiting the carriage, if Hornet hit Kratt, he apologises and claims he was only doing "repairs" and not spying on her, in this state Kratt can be hit again to bounce him to a different location , before offering to let her use the spa free of charge. Visiting him again, Kratt mentions that Hornet is now a "treasured guest". 

If Hornet does not punish Kratt for peeping, she has to pay the {{R|10}} fee again to unlock the spa's door.

After joining the Flea Caravan, Kratt travels with them wherever [[Fleamaster Mooshka]] leads them next.

== Location ==
Kratt can first be found inside a cave behind a breakable wall in [[Greymoor]]. The breakable wall is in the same area as the [[Halfway Home]], on the right and at the top of area, and can only be reached after learning the [[Cling Grip]] ability.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Kratt 01.png!Kratt's location in Greymoor
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Kratt 10.png!The breakable wall leading to Kratt
|Image3 = Screenshot SS Kratt 11.png!Opened passage leading to Kratt
}}

After being rescued, Kratt joins the [[Flea Caravan]] and travels with them. He can be seen standing in front of his metal carriage.

The [[Flea Caravan]] can be found at either [[the Marrow]], [[Greymoor]], [[Blasted Steps]] or [[Fleatopia]], depending on the amount of Fleas found.

== Trivia ==
* Kratt will not react to the [[Needolin]] while trapped in silk, and no dialogue will appear when playing.
* While all the other members of the [[Flea Caravan]] share the same lines of dialogue when Hornet plays the Needolin, Kratt alters those lines to also include himself and put him above the others.
* After punishing Kratt for peeping on her in the spa, Hornet can continue to hit him with her needle, which flings him upwards into the air. The ability to hit Kratt is removed upon leaving the room the Flea Caravan is in.
** If Hornet travels with the Flea Caravan before leaving the room, Kratt will still be able to be hit around in the next location.
** If Kratt is hit into spikes, he bounces off them and cries out in a manner identical to when he is hit by Hornet.
** Hornet is able to hit Kratt into the [[muckmaggot]]-infested waters to the west of Fleatopia, and when hit out of them again Kratt does appear to be infested. This effect is cleared when leaving the room or by hitting Kratt into the pale lake
** None of the members of the Flea Caravan react if Hornet hits Kratt near them.
* If Kratt is among the first 5 Fleas rescued during <i>[[The Lost Fleas]]</i> [[wish]], he has a unique icon in the [[Tasks]] menu screen.
